youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Changing a Flat Tire phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the whole roadside story: discovering the flat, pulling over safely, placing the warning triangle, jacking up the car, swapping the spare, cross-tightening the lug nuts, and driving slowly to the garage. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, the car feels strange.
dialogue.zh: 哎呀，這車開起來怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It pulls hard to the right side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt pʊlz hɑrd tə ðə raɪt saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 它一直往右邊用力偏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen, do you hear that flapping?
dialogue.zh: 你聽，有沒有撲打撲打的聲音？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, like something is slapping the road.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs laɪk ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪz ˈslæpɪŋ ðə roʊd/
dialogue.zh: 有，像有什麼東西在拍地面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The whole back end sits down low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊl bæk ɛnd sɪts daʊn loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 整個後半邊都塌下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, did we just get a flat?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ dɪd wi dʒʌst ɡɛt ə flæt/
dialogue.zh: 天啊，我們是爆胎了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, stay calm, I've got the wheel.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs steɪ kɑm aɪv ɡɑt ðə wil/
dialogue.zh: 是的，別慌，方向盤我穩著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm calm, you're doing great, slow down.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm kɑm ju ər ˈduɪŋ ɡreɪt sloʊ daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 我很冷靜，你做得很好，慢點開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can we pull over safely?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在哪裡安全靠邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a wide shoulder up ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə waɪd ˈʃoʊldər ʌp əˈhɛd/
dialogue.zh: 前方有一段很寬的路肩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll signal right, then drift over.
dialogue.zh: 我打右燈，然後慢慢靠過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blinkers on, moving over slowly now.
dialogue.zh: 方向燈開了，正在慢慢靠過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I won't brake hard, just easing off.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ woʊnt breɪk hɑrd dʒʌst ˈizɪŋ ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 我不急剎，正緩緩鬆油門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we're coasting to the dirt.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們正滑向土路肩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're off the road, but not quite safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪr ɔf ðə roʊd bʌt nɑt kwaɪt seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 我們離開車道了，但還不夠安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep creeping until we're fully off.
dialogue.zh: 再往前挪，直到完全離開路面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it's stopped, engine off, park brake on.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪts stɑpt ˈɛndʒən ɔf pɑrk breɪk ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 好了，引擎關掉，手剎拉起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hazard lights are flashing all around us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæzərd laɪts ər ˈflæʃɪŋ ɔl əˈraʊnd ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 警示燈在車子四周閃個不停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you feel that heavy bump?
dialogue.zh: 你剛剛感覺到那下重震了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we must have run over something.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi mʌst hæv rʌn ˈoʊvər ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 有，我們肯定輾到東西了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's look, but stay alert for cars.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts lʊk bʌt steɪ əˈlɜrt fər kɑrz/
dialogue.zh: 我們去看看，但要小心來車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the mirror before opening your door.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə ˈmɪrər bɪˈfɔr ˈoʊpənɪŋ jɔr dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 開門前先看一下後視鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open it just a crack first.
dialogue.zh: 門先開一條小縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the coast looks clear right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðə koʊst lʊks klɪr raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，這會兒路邊沒有車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Step out on the side away from traffic.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp aʊt ɑn ðə saɪd əˈweɪ frʌm ˈtræfɪk/
dialogue.zh: 從遠離車流的那一側下車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, my shoes are already dusty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt maɪ ʃuz ər ɔlˈrɛdi ˈdʌsti/
dialogue.zh: 明白，我的鞋已經佈滿灰塵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The right rear tire is shredded.
dialogue.zh: 右後輪胎已經磨爛了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is it beyond driving, truly?
dialogue.zh: 真的完全不能開了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Truly, the rubber is torn apart.
dialogue.zh: 真的，橡膠都裂開破掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can see the rim touching ground.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn si ðə rɪm ˈtʌtʃɪŋ ɡraʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 我能看到輪框快貼到地面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was that a nail or just glass?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ðæt ə neɪl ɔr dʒʌst ɡlæs/
dialogue.zh: 剛剛是釘子還是玻璃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see a small screw in the tread.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ə smɔl skru ɪn ðə trɛd/
dialogue.zh: 胎面上有一顆小螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't pull it out yet, okay?
dialogue.zh: 先彆把螺絲拔出來，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why not, it's just a little screw?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ nɑt ɪts dʒʌst ə ˈlɪtəl skru/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼？它只是顆小螺絲呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It plugs the hole for now.
dialogue.zh: 它現在正好堵著那個洞口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh right, air escapes the second it's out.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ raɪt ɛr ɪˈskeɪps ðə ˈsɛkənd ɪts aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 哦對，一拔掉氣就跑光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is that bright warning triangle?
dialogue.zh: 那個亮色三角警示牌在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I think it's in the trunk, under the mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ɪts ɪn ðə trʌŋk ˈʌndər ðə mæt/
dialogue.zh: 應該在行李箱墊板下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pop the trunk, I'll grab my vest.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑp ðə trʌŋk aɪl ɡræb maɪ vɛst/
dialogue.zh: 打開行李箱，我去拿反光背心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's the triangle, folded nice and flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz ðə ˈtraɪəɡəl ˈfoʊldəd naɪs ænd flæt/
dialogue.zh: 三角牌在這，折得整整齊齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Unfold it, the legs snap into place.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌnˈfoʊld ɪt ðə lɛɡz snæp ˈɪntu pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 把它展開，支架會喀一聲卡進定位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this? It stands up on its own.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs ɪt stændz ʌp ɑn ɪts oʊn/
dialogue.zh: 這樣嗎？它自己就能站住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wind tries to take the triangle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɪnd traɪz tə teɪk ðə ˈtraɪəɡəl/
dialogue.zh: 風一直想搶走三角牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set it low, it won't sail away.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ɪt loʊ ɪt woʊnt seɪl əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 放低一點，它就吹不跑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll set it far behind us.
dialogue.zh: 我把它放到我們後面遠處。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How far back is far enough?
dialogue.zh: 往後放多遠才夠？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About one hundred steps. I'll go.
dialogue.zh: 大約一百步。我走一趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hundred? That's a long walk.
dialogue.zh: 一百步？那可走得遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Long enough for drivers to slow down.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ ɪˈnʌf fər ˈdraɪvərz tə sloʊ daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 夠長，才讓司機有時間減速。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good point, walk facing the cars.
dialogue.zh: 有道理，你要面向車流走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, I'll watch the traffic, never my feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt aɪl wɑtʃ ðə ˈtræfɪk ˈnɛvər maɪ fit/
dialogue.zh: 好，我會看著車流，不低頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The road is so windy, be careful.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə roʊd ɪz soʊ ˈwɪndi bi ˈkɛrfəl/
dialogue.zh: 這路段彎多，你小心點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take the phone light with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk ðə foʊn laɪt wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 我把手機手電筒帶上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And take my glowing bracelet too.
dialogue.zh: 把我的發光手環也拿去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's getting dark out here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡天色越來越暗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope your legs are strong tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp jɔr lɛɡz ər strɔŋ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 但願你今晚撐得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm back, it stands bright red.
dialogue.zh: 我回來了，它立在那裡紅彤彤的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, drivers will see us now.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這樣司機們能看到我們了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two cars honked as I walked back.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu kɑrz hʌŋkt æz aɪ wɔkt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 我走回來時，有兩輛車按喇叭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I worried each time one passed close.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈwɜrid itʃ taɪm wʌn pæst kloʊs/
dialogue.zh: 每次有車擦得好近，我都擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come stand by me, away from the lane.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm stænd baɪ mi əˈweɪ frʌm ðə leɪn/
dialogue.zh: 站到我這邊來，離車道遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This trunk side hides us nicely.
dialogue.zh: 有行李箱擋著，我們被遮得好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we call anyone for help?
dialogue.zh: 我們要不要找人來幫忙？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Who could reach us this far out?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu kʊd ritʃ ʌs ðɪs fɑr aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 離城這麼遠，誰能過來？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call the number on our insurance card.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl ðə ˈnʌmbər ɑn ɑr ɪnˈʃʊrəns kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 打保險卡上的那支電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, it says twenty-four-hour help.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə ɪt sɛz ˈtwɛnti fɔr ˈaʊr hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 對，上面寫著全天救援。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No signal, one sad empty bar.
dialogue.zh: 沒有訊號，只剩一格空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My phone shows nothing either.
dialogue.zh: 我的手機也完全沒訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wave cars, then. Maybe one will stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪv kɑrz ðɛn ˈmeɪbi wʌn wɪl stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 那就揮手攔車，說不定有人停。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody likes stopping on this highway.
dialogue.zh: 沒人愛在這種快速路上停車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one slowed, then hurried away.
dialogue.zh: 這輛車慢下來，又趕緊開走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: People fear a stopped car ahead.
dialogue.zh: 大家看到路肩停著車都害怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're on our own, then?
dialogue.zh: 所以只能靠我們自己了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'd rather fix it than wait all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd ˈræðər fɪks ɪt ðæn weɪt ɔl naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我也寧可自己修，不想乾等一整晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we even own a spare tire?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ˈivən oʊn ə spɛr ˈtaɪər/
dialogue.zh: 我們到底有沒有備胎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I believe it waits under the trunk floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɪˈliv ɪt weɪts ˈʌndər ðə trʌŋk flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 應該就收在行李箱地板下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And do we have the right tools?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd du wi hæv ðə raɪt tuːlz/
dialogue.zh: 那工具有沒有齊全？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A jack and a wrench, I hope.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dʒæk ænd ə rɛntʃ aɪ hoʊp/
dialogue.zh: 希望真有千斤頂和扳手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you ever changed a tire yourself?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju ˈɛvər tʃeɪndʒd ə ˈtaɪər jɔrˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 你自己換過輪胎嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, I've only watched my father do it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər aɪv ˈoʊnli wɑtʃt maɪ ˈfɑðər du ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我只看過我爸操作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, never done it either.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，我也從沒換過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we'll learn it tonight, together.
dialogue.zh: 那今晚我們就一起學會它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My heart is beating like crazy.
dialogue.zh: 我心跳快得像發狂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, but it's just a tire.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu bʌt ɪts dʒʌst ə ˈtaɪər/
dialogue.zh: 我也是，不過就是一條胎嘛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just a tire with four people on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə ˈtaɪər wɪð fɔr ˈpipəl ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是一條載著四個人的輪胎啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the right kind of worry.
dialogue.zh: 會這樣擔心就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kids are calm in the back seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɪdz ər kɑm ɪn ðə bæk sit/
dialogue.zh: 孩子們在後座還安安靜靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're drawing, bless their little hearts.
dialogue.zh: 他們在畫畫，真讓人心疼又安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep them buckled while we work.
dialogue.zh: 我們忙的時候讓他們繫好安全帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, and doors stay locked.
dialogue.zh: 那當然，車門也會鎖著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One good thing: we're not on a bridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɡʊd θɪŋ wɪr nɑt ɑn ə brɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 好在我們沒停在橋上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, this shoulder is wide and flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru ðɪs ˈʃoʊldər ɪz waɪd ænd flæt/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，這路肩寬又平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still, trucks pass way too close.
dialogue.zh: 但卡車還是擦得好近。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ground shakes with every one.
dialogue.zh: 每一輛經過地都在抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can be scared a little later.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn bi skɛrd ə ˈlɪtəl ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 害怕可以留到稍後再說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, fear can wait in the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid fɪr kæn weɪt ɪn ðə kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 好，害怕就在車裡等著吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The spare can't drive fast or far.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə spɛr kænt draɪv fæst ɔr fɑr/
dialogue.zh: 備胎不能開快，也開不遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a garage twenty miles ahead.
dialogue.zh: 前面二十英里就有一家修車廠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then it just needs to last the drive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt dʒʌst nidz tə læst ðə draɪv/
dialogue.zh: 那它只要能撐過這段路就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big job for one tiny spare.
dialogue.zh: 小小備胎攤上大任務了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back to the trunk, hold the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk tə ðə trʌŋk hoʊld ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 再回到行李箱這兒，幫我扶住蓋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's up high, now look under the mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ʌp haɪ naʊ lʊk ˈʌndər ðə mæt/
dialogue.zh: 蓋子掀高了，快看墊板下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This round black thing is the spare?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs raʊnd blæk θɪŋ ɪz ðə spɛr/
dialogue.zh: 這個圓圓黑黑的東西就是備胎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, small but strong enough.
dialogue.zh: 對，雖然小但夠結實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's chained down by one big screw.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts tʃeɪnd daʊn baɪ wʌn bɪɡ skrʊ/
dialogue.zh: 它被一顆大螺絲固定住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which tool turns that screw off?
dialogue.zh: 哪個工具能轉開它？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wheel wrench, the long shiny one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wil rɛntʃ ðə lɔŋ ˈʃaɪni wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 輪胎扳手，那根長長亮亮的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, it's inside the black plastic case.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪts ɪnˈsaɪd ðə blæk ˈplæstɪk keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 在這，收在黑色塑膠盒裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fit the socket onto the screw head.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪt ðə ˈsɑkɪt ˈɑntu ðə skrʊ hɛd/
dialogue.zh: 把套筒套進螺絲頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It snaps in, now which way?
dialogue.zh: 喀一聲卡好了，現在往哪邊轉？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Left, always left to loosen.
dialogue.zh: 向左，鬆開永遠往左轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like opening a tight jar lid.
dialogue.zh: 就像轉開很緊的玻璃罐蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This screw fights me hard.
dialogue.zh: 這顆螺絲好擰不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lean into it, use your whole arm.
dialogue.phonetic: /lin ˈɪntu ɪt juz jɔr hoʊl ɑrm/
dialogue.zh: 身體壓上去，整條手臂使勁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There — it finally turned!
dialogue.zh: 動了——終於轉開了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep spinning it till it's loose.
dialogue.zh: 繼續轉到完全鬆開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, it drops right onto toes.
dialogue.zh: 小心，掉了會砸到腳趾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Caught it! My toes thank you.
dialogue.zh: 接住了！腳趾們感謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lift the tire out with both hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft ðə ˈtaɪər aʊt wɪð boʊθ hænz/
dialogue.zh: 兩手把備胎抱出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's heavier than a full backpack.
dialogue.zh: 比裝滿的背包還重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lean it against the bumper there.
dialogue.zh: 讓它斜靠在保險桿邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, it stays there nicely.
dialogue.zh: 好了，它斜靠在那兒挺穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now hunt for the car jack.
dialogue.zh: 現在找出千斤頂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wasn't it hooked under the trunk door?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɑzənt ɪt hʊkt ˈʌndər ðə trʌŋk dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 是不是掛在行李箱蓋內側？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, here it is, the scissor kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hɪr ɪt ɪz ðə ˈsɪsər kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，是剪刀式的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks so thin for lifting a car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lʊks soʊ θɪn fər ˈlɪftɪŋ ə kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 這麼細，真能抬起整台車？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thin but mighty, trust the metal.
dialogue.zh: 細是細，力氣大，信這塊鐵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And this handle goes where?
dialogue.zh: 那這根搖桿插哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Find the hole in the rear bumper.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪnd ðə hoʊl ɪn ðə rɪr ˈbʌmpər/
dialogue.zh: 在後保險桿上找那個孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This little round opening?
dialogue.zh: 這個小圓孔嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Push the handle in till it catches.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ðə ˈhændəl ɪn tɪl ɪt ˈkætʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 搖桿插進去直到卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It grips, now I turn it?
dialogue.zh: 咬合住了，現在轉它？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clockwise raises, other way lowers.
dialogue.zh: 順時針升高，反向就下降。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same as the hands of a clock?
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm æz ðə hændz ʌv ə klɑk/
dialogue.zh: 跟時鐘指針一個方向？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, turn along with time.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，順著時間轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So raising means clockwise, easy.
dialogue.zh: 那就是順時針升高，簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the wrench for the lug nuts.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə rɛntʃ fər ðə lʌɡ nʌts/
dialogue.zh: 接著用扳手對付輪轂螺帽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The little caps hide five nuts.
dialogue.zh: 小蓋子後面藏著五顆螺帽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pop the plastic cover off first.
dialogue.zh: 先把塑膠輪蓋摳下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Off it comes, there are the nuts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔf ɪt kʌmz ðɛr ər ðə nʌts/
dialogue.zh: 摳下來了，螺帽露出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loosen them only half a turn now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlusən ðɛm ˈoʊnli hæf ə tɜrn naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在每顆只鬆半圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why only half, not all the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ˈoʊnli hæf nɑt ɔl ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼只鬆一半？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A floating wheel just spins around.
dialogue.zh: 懸空的輪子一轉就跟著空轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, the ground holds it still.
dialogue.zh: 哦，有地面壓著才轉不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See? Physics helps us tonight.
dialogue.zh: 看吧？物理今晚站在我們這邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Physics and a wrench, my favorite team.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪzɪks ænd ə rɛntʃ maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt tim/
dialogue.zh: 物理加扳手，我最愛的隊伍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press down on the wrench end.
dialogue.zh: 往下壓扳手這一頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm standing on it now!
dialogue.zh: 我整個人都站上去了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gently, we need your ankle.
dialogue.zh: 輕點，腳踝還要用呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, that's just my old habit.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我就是愛使蠻力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Each nut gets one half turn.
dialogue.zh: 每顆螺帽各鬆半圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which nut do I start with?
dialogue.zh: 我該先鬆哪一顆？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Top one, then the bottom left.
dialogue.zh: 先頂上那顆，再左下角。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like drawing a big star.
dialogue.zh: 像在畫一顆大星星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, star order keeps the wheel steady.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs stɑr ˈɔrdər kips ðə wil ˈstɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 對，星形順序輪胎才穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steady wheel, happy me.
dialogue.zh: 輪胎穩，我就安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All five are loose but stay on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl faɪv ər lus bʌt steɪ ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 五顆都鬆了但先別取下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now the car can rise.
dialogue.zh: 好，現在可以升車了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slide the jack under the marked point.
dialogue.phonetic: /slaɪd ðə dʒæk ˈʌndər ðə mɑrkt pɔɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 把千斤頂塞到標記點下方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where exactly should metal touch metal?
dialogue.zh: 鐵對鐵，到底該頂在車底哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, the notch behind the rear door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ðə nɑtʃ bɪˈhaɪnd ðə rɪr dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 在那兒，後門底下的凹口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see the little cut in the frame.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ðə ˈlɪtəl kʌt ɪn ðə freɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我看到車架上的小缺口了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the handle till the jack touches.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə ˈhændəl tɪl ðə dʒæk ˈtʌtʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 轉搖桿直到千斤頂貼住車底。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It kisses the frame, not lifting yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈkɪsɪz ðə freɪm nɑt ˈlɪftɪŋ jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 它輕輕貼上了，還沒開始抬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, it's perfectly centered now.
dialogue.zh: 很好，現在頂得正正的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready for some serious turning?
dialogue.zh: 準備認真轉搖桿了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crank smooth circles, keep breathing.
dialogue.zh: 一圈圈穩穩轉，記得呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The car creaks as it lifts.
dialogue.zh: 車子升高時吱吱作響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's rising, look at the gap grow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈraɪzɪŋ lʊk æt ðə ɡæp ɡroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 在升了，看縫隙越來越大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should the tire leave the ground?
dialogue.zh: 輪胎要離地多高？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just a fist's height above the road.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə fɪsts haɪt əˈbʌv ðə roʊd/
dialogue.zh: 離地一個拳頭高就夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's plenty of room for the swap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈplɛnti ʌv rum fər ðə swɑp/
dialogue.zh: 換胎的空間足夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep one hand on the handle.
dialogue.zh: 一隻手始終扶著搖桿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one eye on the car?
dialogue.zh: 另一隻眼睛盯著車身？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, it should never lean.
dialogue.zh: 對，它一點都不能歪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's standing level so far.
dialogue.zh: 目前一直平平穩穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never slide under a lifted car.
dialogue.zh: 千萬別鑽到升起的車底。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noted, my body stays outside.
dialogue.zh: 收到，我整個人待在車外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more spin, then test the wheel.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr spɪn ðɛn tɛst ðə wil/
dialogue.zh: 再轉一圈，然後試試輪子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push it and see if it turns.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ɪt ænd si ɪf ɪt tɜrnz/
dialogue.zh: 推一下看它轉不轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It spins freely, that's perfect.
dialogue.zh: 它輕鬆轉動，完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Freely spinning, safely held up.
dialogue.zh: 轉得動，也撐得穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The old tire can finally come off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði oʊld ˈtaɪər kæn ˈfaɪnəli kʌm ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 舊胎終於能拆下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do we take the nuts off now?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi teɪk ðə nʌts ɔf naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在把螺帽全擰下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, unscrew them one by one.
dialogue.zh: 對，一顆一顆擰下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep them safe in your pocket.
dialogue.zh: 放進口袋保管好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My pocket is now full of hardware.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈpɑkɪt ɪz naʊ fʊl ʌv ˈhɑrdˌwɛr/
dialogue.zh: 我口袋現在叮噹作響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rattle rattle, my pocket orchestra.
dialogue.zh: 叮叮噹噹，口袋小樂團。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last nut, and it fights me again.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst nʌt ænd ɪt faɪts mi əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 最後一顆，它又跟我作對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wiggle the wrench and breathe out.
dialogue.zh: 晃晃扳手，吐口氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come loose, you stubborn little thing.
dialogue.zh: 鬆開吧，你這固執的小東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're arguing with a nut now.
dialogue.zh: 你居然在跟螺帽講道理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There we go, all five are free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr wi ɡoʊ ɔl faɪv ər fri/
dialogue.zh: 你看，五顆全下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab the tire by its sides.
dialogue.zh: 兩手抓住輪胎兩側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It sticks to the bolts a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɪks tə ðə boʊlts ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 它還有一點黏在螺柱上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap the rim around with the wrench.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ðə rɪm əˈraʊnd wɪð ðə rɛntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 用扳手沿著輪框敲一圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One good pull and it slides off.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɡʊd pʊl ænd ɪt slaɪdz ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 用力一拉它就滑下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull it toward you, not down.
dialogue.zh: 往你懷裡帶，別往下墜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free at last, careful hands.
dialogue.zh: 終於下來了，手要穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roll it aside like a giant coin.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊl ɪt əˈsaɪd laɪk ə ˈdʒaɪənt kɔɪn/
dialogue.zh: 像枚大硬幣一樣把它滾到一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, off you roll, old tire.
dialogue.zh: 好了，你滾去路邊吧，老夥計。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lay it flat by the grass, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪ ɪt flæt baɪ ðə ɡræs pliz/
dialogue.zh: 請把它平放到草邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down it goes, lighter than expected.
dialogue.zh: 放下了，比想像中輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now bring the spare to the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ brɪŋ ðə spɛr tə ðə kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 現在把備胎搬到車邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Give me a hand with this wheel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv mi ə hænd wɪð ðɪs wil/
dialogue.zh: 這輪胎搭把手一起抬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both hands on the bottom edge.
dialogue.zh: 兩手都托住下緣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lift on three, nice and steady.
dialogue.zh: 數到三再抬，穩穩的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One, two, three — it's up!
dialogue.zh: 一、二、三——抬起來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guide it onto the bolt posts.
dialogue.zh: 對準螺柱慢慢套進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The holes don't match yet.
dialogue.zh: 孔位還對不上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn it slightly, the pattern repeats.
dialogue.zh: 稍微轉一下，孔是規律排的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, every hole looks the same.
dialogue.zh: 對，每個孔看起來一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slide it onto the bolts now.
dialogue.zh: 現在順著螺柱套進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The holes almost match, one push.
dialogue.zh: 孔快對上了，再推一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's it, it's on halfway.
dialogue.zh: 對了，已經進去一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Squeeze the wheel toward the hub.
dialogue.zh: 把輪胎往輪轂中心推貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it rests right against the brake.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt rɛsts raɪt əˈɡɛnst ðə breɪk/
dialogue.zh: 現在緊緊貼住剎車盤了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No gap at all, nice seating.
dialogue.zh: 一點縫隙都沒有，裝得服服帖帖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Start every nut with your fingers.
dialogue.zh: 每顆螺帽先用手擰上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finger tight, then the wrench finishes.
dialogue.zh: 擰到手擰不動，再由扳手收工。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why not just use the wrench?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼不直接用扳手？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By hand, they start straight.
dialogue.zh: 用手擰才不會把螺紋擰歪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cross threads would strip the bolts.
dialogue.zh: 螺紋錯位會毀掉螺柱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood, fingers first, five times.
dialogue.zh: 懂了，先用手，一共五顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one threads like butter.
dialogue.zh: 這顆順得像切黃油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine is a bit stubborn.
dialogue.zh: 我這顆有點不聽話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back it out, then try again.
dialogue.zh: 退出來，再重新擰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, now it turns smooth.
dialogue.zh: 啊，現在順了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See, patience pays in nuts.
dialogue.zh: 看吧，耐心是有回報的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that an old mechanic's saying?
dialogue.zh: 這是老師傅的格言嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All five nuts are now snug.
dialogue.zh: 五顆螺帽都初步鎖上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snug means barely tight, right?
dialogue.zh: 初步就是剛好不鬆，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, now tighten in the star pattern.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs naʊ ˈtaɪtən ɪn ðə stɑr ˈpætərn/
dialogue.zh: 對，現在按星形順序鎖緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Top, then bottom right, then bottom left?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɑp ðɛn ˈbɑtəm raɪt ðɛn ˈbɑtəm lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 頂上，再右下，再左下？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You remembered the order!
dialogue.zh: 你居然記得這個順序！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I watch everything you do.
dialogue.zh: 你做的每一步我都看著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wrench wants strong, short pulls.
dialogue.zh: 扳手要用短促的猛力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this, pulling toward the wheel?
dialogue.zh: 像這樣，朝輪胎方向拉？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, pull down across your body.
dialogue.zh: 對，往斜下方用體重拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oomph! That nut is done.
dialogue.zh: 嘿咻！這顆鎖好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Round the star till all five sing tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /raʊnd ðə stɑr tɪl ɔl faɪv sɪŋ taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 星形繞圈，直到五顆全鎖緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sing tight, I'll knock on the tire.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪŋ taɪt aɪl nɑk ɑn ðə ˈtaɪər/
dialogue.zh: 鎖緊與否，我敲敲輪胎聽聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A solid sound means good pressure.
dialogue.zh: 聲音沉實就代表壓力夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine sounds like a full drum.
dialogue.zh: 我這聽起來像飽滿的鼓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lower the car before the final pull.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈloʊər ðə kɑr bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈfaɪnəl pʊl/
dialogue.zh: 最後一次鎖緊前要先把車降下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why, aren't they tight enough?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼，還不夠緊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wheel must touch ground to press.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wil mʌst tʌtʃ ɡraʊnd tə prɛs/
dialogue.zh: 輪胎著地才頂得住大力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, so it won't spin again.
dialogue.zh: 哦，這樣它才不會又空轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the handle the other way now.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə ˈhændəl ði ˈʌðər weɪ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在把搖桿往反方向轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Backward, and down comes the car.
dialogue.zh: 往回轉，車緩緩落下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slowly, slow, let it settle.
dialogue.zh: 慢點再慢點，讓車自己坐穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The springs sigh, we're back on earth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sprɪŋz saɪ wɪr bæk ɑn ɜrθ/
dialogue.zh: 彈簧一聲輕嘆，車回到地面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pull the jack out from underneath.
dialogue.zh: 把千斤頂從車底抽出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It slides free, easy come easy go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt slaɪdz fri ˈizi kʌm ˈizi ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 輕鬆抽出，來去都順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The jack is greasy, fold it flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒæk ɪz ˈɡrisi foʊld ɪt flæt/
dialogue.zh: 千斤頂油膩膩的，折平收起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Folded, hooked, back in its corner.
dialogue.zh: 摺好、掛好，回到它那角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Final pulls, one nut at a time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfaɪnəl pʊlz wʌn nʌt æt ə taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 最後補鎖，一顆一顆來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This wrench feels different on the ground.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs rɛntʃ filz ˈdɪfərənt ɑn ðə ɡraʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 車子落地後扳手感覺不一樣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Because the tire holds still now.
dialogue.zh: 因為現在輪胎紋絲不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So my whole pull reaches the nut.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ hoʊl pʊl rɪtʃɪz ðə nʌt/
dialogue.zh: 所以我使的力全都到了螺帽上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, that's the whole trick.
dialogue.zh: 一點不錯，訣竅就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five strong nuts, one proud me.
dialogue.zh: 五顆擰得死緊，我驕傲極了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Give each one a friendly tap test.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv itʃ wʌn ə ˈfrɛndli tæp tɛst/
dialogue.zh: 每顆都輕敲一下做檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tapped them all, none moved an inch.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæpt ðɛm ɔl nʌn muvd ən ɪntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 全敲過了，一動也不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Push the wheel, feel for looseness.
dialogue.zh: 推推輪胎，試試有沒有鬆動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rock-solid, you worked your magic.
dialogue.zh: 結實得像磐石，你果然會變魔術。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only physics and your good hands.
dialogue.zh: 不過是物理學加你的巧手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The jack leaves a clean round mark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒæk livz ə klin raʊnd mɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 千斤頂在車底留下圓圓的印子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's normal, it pressed the frame.
dialogue.zh: 正常，是頂過來的痕跡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll wipe it later with some spray.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl waɪp ɪt ˈleɪtər wɪð sʌm spreɪ/
dialogue.zh: 回頭我拿噴劑擦掉它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wipe your hands, job well done.
dialogue.zh: 擦擦手，這活乾得漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We really did change a tire!
dialogue.zh: 我們真的換了一條輪胎！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say that again for the dark road.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ðæt əˈɡɛn fər ðə dɑrk roʊd/
dialogue.zh: 對著這條夜路再說一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We, changed, a, tire!
dialogue.zh: 我們——換——了——輪——胎！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The car sits level on its new wheel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑr sɪts ˈlɛvəl ɑn ɪts nu wil/
dialogue.zh: 車子四平八穩地立在新的輪子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks like a proper car again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lʊks laɪk ə ˈprɑpər kɑr əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 看起來終於又是一台正常的車了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The odd spare gives it new charm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɑd spɛr ɡɪvz ɪt nu tʃɑrm/
dialogue.zh: 這條特別的備胎反而添了魅力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Funny or not, it saves us tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfʌni ɔr nɑt ɪt seɪvz ʌs təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 管它怪不怪，今晚它救了我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check the old tire once more.
dialogue.zh: 再檢查一下那條舊胎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screw still sits deep inside.
dialogue.zh: 那顆螺絲還深深紮在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Note the hole, right by the tread edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊt ðə hoʊl raɪt baɪ ðə trɛd ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 記住那個破口，就在胎面邊緣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shop can patch that in minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɑp kæn pætʃ ðæt ɪn ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 修理店幾分鐘就能補好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the rim bent enough to worry?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə rɪm bɛnt ɪˈnʌf tə ˈwɜri/
dialogue.zh: 輪框彎得讓人擔心嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks fine, just a few scratches.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lʊks faɪn dʒʌst ə fju ˈskrætʃəz/
dialogue.zh: 看著還好，只有幾道刮痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we roll the flat into the trunk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi roʊl ðə flæt ˈɪntu ðə trʌŋk/
dialogue.zh: 那我們把壞胎滾進行李箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It barely fits, the lid won't close.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈbɛrli fɪts ðə lɪd woʊnt kloʊz/
dialogue.zh: 塞得滿滿的，蓋子關不上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leave it open, hazards on, all set.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt ˈoʊpən ˈhæzərdz ɑn ɔl sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 蓋子就開著，警示燈閃著，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And your triangle? Fetch it back too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd jɔr ˈtraɪəɡəl fɛtʃ ɪt bæk tu/
dialogue.zh: 還有你的三角牌？也順路拿回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One trip, triangle and tools, done.
dialogue.zh: 跑一趟，三角牌和工具一起收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Screw pulled out, bagged, tools packed away.
dialogue.phonetic: /skru pʊld aʊt bæɡd tuːlz pækt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 螺絲拔下來收進袋子，工具也歸位了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count the nuts, did we lose one?
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ðə nʌts dɪd wi luz wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 數數螺帽，有沒有掉一顆？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One, two, three, four, five, all here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tu θri fɔr faɪv ɔl hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 一二三四五，一顆都不少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, missing nuts cause wobbling.
dialogue.zh: 很好，少了螺帽輪子會抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No wobbling planned for our ride home.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɑbəlɪŋ plænd fər ɑr raɪd hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 回家的路上才不要抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tuck the vest under the passenger seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʌk ðə vɛst ˈʌndər ðə ˈpæsəndʒər sit/
dialogue.zh: 把背心收在副駕座位下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And my dusty shoes need a knock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd maɪ ˈdʌsti ʃuz nid ə nɑk/
dialogue.zh: 我那灰撲撲的鞋子也該敲敲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll celebrate with warm drinks ahead.
dialogue.zh: 前面我們喝杯熱的慶祝一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hot cocoa at the gas station?
dialogue.zh: 到加油站喝杯熱可可嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, after one last circle of the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈæftər wʌn læst ˈsɜrkəl ʌv ðə kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 好，不過先繞車最後檢查一圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Windows shut, doors latched, all good.
dialogue.zh: 窗戶關好，門也扣緊，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Buckle up, let's start the engine.
dialogue.zh: 繫好安全帶，我們發動引擎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It purrs like nothing happened.
dialogue.zh: 引擎平順得像什麼都沒發生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ease onto the road, first gear.
dialogue.zh: 掛一檔慢慢滑上路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice and slow, watching the mirror.
dialogue.zh: 又輕又慢，時時盯著後視鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The spare hums a different tune.
dialogue.zh: 備胎哼的曲調不太一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that hum normal or a warning?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt hʌm ˈnɔrməl ɔr ə ˈwɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 這嗡嗡聲是正常的還是警告？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Normal, its tread is just narrower.
dialogue.zh: 正常，它的胎面比較窄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So she sings in a higher voice.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ʃi sɪŋz ɪn ə ˈhaɪər vɔɪs/
dialogue.zh: 所以它唱起歌來音調高些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stay under fifty, no passing.
dialogue.zh: 保持時速五十以下，不超車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood, my foot stays light.
dialogue.zh: 收到，我的油門踩得很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the garage still be open?
dialogue.zh: 那家修車廠還會開著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They close at eight, it's seven now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ kloʊz æt eɪt ɪts ˈsɛvən naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 他們八點關門，現在七點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So home tonight, tire shop tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 那就今晚先回家，明天再去輪胎店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's tire sealant in the glove box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ˈtaɪər ˈsilənt ɪn ðə ɡlʌv bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 副駕手套箱裡還有一罐補胎液。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sealant buys time for a real tire.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsilənt baɪz taɪm fər ə ril ˈtaɪər/
dialogue.zh: 補胎液能撐到換一條新胎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A good reason to drive easy tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡʊd ˈrizən tə draɪv ˈizi təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這也是今晚慢慢開的好理由。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mile markers, how far to town?
dialogue.zh: 看下里程碑，進城還遠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten more, then a bright gas station.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn mɔr ðɛn ə braɪt ɡæs ˈsteɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 還有十英里，就有個明亮的加油站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, we'll check the spare there.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，到那兒檢查備胎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Air pumps save many journeys.
dialogue.zh: 打氣機救過無數的旅程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kids slept through all the drama.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɪdz slɛpt θru ɔl ðə ˈdrɑmə/
dialogue.zh: 孩子們一覺睡過了全部折騰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleeping kids keep every ride calm.
dialogue.zh: 睡著的孩子讓每段路都安穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll buy us the biggest coffee.
dialogue.zh: 我要請我們喝最大杯的咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With the cream swirl on top?
dialogue.zh: 上面還有奶油花那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two sugars, extra hot, of course.
dialogue.zh: 加兩包糖，要很燙，當然。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You know the rescue drink well.
dialogue.zh: 你真懂什麼是救援飲品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The warning light blinked, then died.
dialogue.zh: 儀表警示燈閃了一下就滅了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Was that the tire talking to us?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ðæt ðə ˈtaɪər ˈtɔkɪŋ tə ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 是輪胎在跟我們說話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time, we check tires monthly.
dialogue.zh: 下次開始，我們每月檢查輪胎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And keep a flashlight by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd kip ə ˈflæʃˌlaɪt baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 門邊再常備一支手電筒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gas station lights, I see them!
dialogue.zh: 加油站的燈光，我看到了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull under the canopy, it's bright.
dialogue.zh: 開到棚架底下，那裡最亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This air pump should read true.
dialogue.zh: 這台打氣機讀數應該準。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the spare's pressure first.
dialogue.zh: 先量量備胎的氣壓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty pounds, the sticker says.
dialogue.zh: 貼紙寫著要六十磅氣壓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gauge reads forty, add air.
dialogue.zh: 表上只有四十，趕快補氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fill it in bursts, watch the dial.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪl ɪt ɪn bɜrsts wɑtʃ ðə ˈdaɪəl/
dialogue.zh: 一陣一陣地充氣，盯緊氣壓表。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It climbs, it climbs, almost there.
dialogue.zh: 在升，在升，快到位了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, sixty flat, cap it back on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ˈsɪksti flæt kæp ɪt bæk ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 好了，正六十磅，閥蓋鎖回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The spare grins, full of air.
dialogue.zh: 備胎鼓著嘴，充滿元氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clerk waves, he saw it all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɜrk weɪvz hi sɔ ɪt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 店員在揮手，他全瞧見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says many flats happen here.
dialogue.zh: 他說這條路常有人爆胎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Asks if we need a new tire today.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsks ɪf wi nid ə nu ˈtaɪər təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 他問我們今天要不要換新胎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have the spare, so maybe not.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv ðə spɛr soʊ ˈmeɪbi nɑt/
dialogue.zh: 我們有備胎，所以先不用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He offers his phone to call home.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ˈɔfərz hɪz foʊn tə kɔl hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 他把手機借給我們打電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kind man, our phones are still dead.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaɪnd mæn ɑr foʊnz ər stɪl dɛd/
dialogue.zh: 真好心，我們的手機還沒訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll call Grandma, she's waiting up.
dialogue.zh: 我打電話給奶奶，她還在等我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her we're safe and cocoa-hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɜr wɪr seɪf ænd ˈkoʊkoʊ hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 告訴她我們平安，還喝熱可可。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our plan, honestly, worked out.
dialogue.zh: 我們的計畫，說真的，成功了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our plan was not to panic loudly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr plæn wʌz nɑt tə ˈpænɪk ˈlaʊdli/
dialogue.zh: 我們的計畫就是別大驚小怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Home is close now, fifteen miles.
dialogue.zh: 家近了，只剩十五英里。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The little spare carries us proudly.
dialogue.zh: 小小的備胎自豪地馱著我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we just pass our exit sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd wi dʒʌst pæs ɑr ˈɛɡzɪt saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我們剛錯過出口指標嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the next blue sign is ours.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə nɛkst blu saɪn ɪz ɑrz/
dialogue.zh: 沒，下一個藍色指標就是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our street, at last — look at it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr strit æt læst lʊk æt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 看，我們的街道，終於到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The porch light is on for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɔrtʃ laɪt ɪz ɑn fər ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 門廊的燈是為我們留的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Roll in slowly, the driveway's here.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢開進車道，到家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Engine off, silence, we made it.
dialogue.zh: 引擎關掉，一片安靜，我們做到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow, one tire goes to the shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ wʌn ˈtaɪər ɡoʊz tə ðə ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 明天，一條輪胎要送去修。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one big thank-you to the wrench.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wʌn bɪɡ θæŋk ju tə ðə rɛntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 還要大大感謝那把扳手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep well, tire hero of the night.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip wɛl ˈtaɪər ˈhɪroʊ ʌv ðə naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好好睡吧，今晚的輪胎英雄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did the turning, I did the cheering.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪd ðə ˈtɜrnɪŋ aɪ dɪd ðə ˈtʃɪrɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 你出力擰螺帽，我出力喊加油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We both earned the soft blankets.
dialogue.zh: 我們都值得蓋軟軟的毯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hot shower first, then blankets forever.
dialogue.zh: 先洗熱水澡，再鑽進被窩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands still smell like the road.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hænz stɪl smɛl laɪk ðə roʊd/
dialogue.zh: 我的手還有柏油路的氣味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soap twice, then the mystery fades.
dialogue.zh: 洗兩遍肥皂，味道就散了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spare me the story at breakfast?
dialogue.zh: 早餐時能否別提這段故事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No promises, it's a great story.
dialogue.zh: 不敢保證，它太精彩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the alarm, tire shop at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ði əˈlɑrm ˈtaɪər ʃɑp æt naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 設好鬧鐘，九點去輪胎店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With the flat and the little screw.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð ðə flæt ænd ðə ˈlɪtəl skru/
dialogue.zh: 載上壞胎和那顆小螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will they match our car's old tires?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðeɪ mætʃ ɑr kɑrz oʊld ˈtaɪərz/
dialogue.zh: 他們換的胎會跟車上現有的搭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same size, same brand if possible.
dialogue.zh: 盡量尺寸和牌子都一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or they'll suggest two matched new ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr ðeɪl səɡˈdʒɛst tu mætʃt nu wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 或者他們會建議換兩條配對新胎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same on both sides, smooth on the road.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ɑn boʊθ saɪdz smuð ɑn ðə roʊd/
dialogue.zh: 兩側一樣，路上才平穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Budget, coffee, and a new tire.
dialogue.zh: 預算、咖啡，還有一條新胎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sounds like a pleasant Saturday errand.
dialogue.zh: 聽起來是個愜意的週六差事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank the moon, it lit our work.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ðə mun ɪt lɪt ɑr wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝月亮，它照亮了我們的手藝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the triangle that stood guard.
dialogue.zh: 也謝謝那個站崗的三角牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next flat, we'll be old pros.
dialogue.zh: 下次爆胎，我們就是老手了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it be ten long years from now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt bi tɛn lɔŋ jɪrz frʌm naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 但願十年之內都別再爆胎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kids will learn, someday, too.
dialogue.zh: 孩子們總有一天也會學換胎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By then, cars may not need jacks.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðɛn kɑrz meɪ nɑt nid dʒæks/
dialogue.zh: 到那時說不定車都不用千斤頂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Until then, gloves and vest stay ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌnˈtɪl ðɛn ɡlʌvz ænd vɛst steɪ ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 在那之前，手套背心隨時待命。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The flashlight joins them by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈflæʃˌlaɪt dʒɔɪnz ðɛm baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 手電筒在門邊跟它們會合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My back aches in five new spots.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæk eɪks ɪn faɪv nu spɑts/
dialogue.zh: 我的背多了五個痠痛點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow's soreness, tonight's trophy.
dialogue.zh: 明天的痠痛，是今晚的獎盃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we tell anyone our tale?
dialogue.zh: 要把我們的故事說給誰聽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll post it tomorrow, to help someone.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil poʊst ɪt təˈmɑroʊ tə hɛlp ˈsʌmˌwʌn/
dialogue.zh: 明天發上去，說不定能幫到誰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clerk wrote down a garage for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɜrk roʊt daʊn ə ɡəˈrɑʒ fər ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 加油站店員幫我們寫下一家修車廠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save it, so the morning call is easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ɪt soʊ ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ kɔl ɪz ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 存好號碼，明早打電話就輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow, the trunk holds only the flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ ðə trʌŋk hoʊldz ˈoʊnli ðə flæt/
dialogue.zh: 明天行李箱只裝那條壞胎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plus the screw, our tiny villain.
dialogue.zh: 還有那顆螺絲，我們的小壞蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep now, road warrior.
dialogue.zh: 睡吧，馬路上的戰士。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep, tire-changing champion of the world.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip ˈtaɪər ˈtʃeɪndʒɪŋ ʃæmˈpiən ʌv ðə wɜrld/
dialogue.zh: 睡吧，世界換胎冠軍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dream of smooth empty highways.
dialogue.zh: 夢一條平順空闊的高速公路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a tire that never hisses.
dialogue.zh: 還有一條永不漏氣的輪胎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning brings new rubber friends.
dialogue.zh: 清晨會帶來新的橡膠夥伴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight, we rest, the tire waits.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們休息，讓輪胎等著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good work tonight, team of two.
dialogue.zh: 今晚乾得漂亮，雙人小隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good work, tire whisperers, good night.
dialogue.zh: 幹得真好，聽胎人，晚安。
